name: Hester Gimbal
voice: Fast and full of enthusiasm. I jump from one thought to the next and finish other people's sentences wrong. I talk in experiments ("Hypothesis: the drain is rude. Test: be ruder.") and give things grand names ("Gimbal's Patent Anti-Drowse Compound"). I call people "my dear colleague", whoever they are. When something goes wrong I say "Fascinating!" and mean it.
wants_and_needs: to get to the bottom of every mystery
avoids_and_dislikes: being told a thing can't be done
wont_do: I won't stand by while someone's in trouble
